create_register_coco_zeroshot_splits: register COCO zero-shot train and val dataset splits with detectron2 using predefined categories
build_get_metadata_seen: build metadata dict for COCO zero-shot seen categories with id-to-contiguous-id mapping and class names
build_get_metadata_unseen: build metadata dict for COCO zero-shot unseen categories with id-to-contiguous-id mapping and class names
create_register_custom_coco_splits: register custom COCO dataset splits from CC3M and SBU sources with LVIS-style registration
run_get_zero_shot_weight_mask: compute zero-shot category weight mask tensor from COCO train annotation JSON file
